cohort: A 38-year-old pregnant woman presenting at 27 weeks+3 days of gestation with early-onset foetal growth restriction and preeclampsia.
finding: Optimal monitoring and timing of delivery are crucial in the management of early-onset foetal growth restriction to achieve a balance between prolonging pregnancy and preventing mortality/morbidity.
mod_finding: A caesarean section was performed at 31 weeks+5 days of gestation due to worsening maternal conditions.
followup_time: at least 2 days post-birth for newborn's breathing
